nodes.label:
Opened by the app:showQuickMenuN actions, where N is the page position: reordering pages changes which page a key opens. Each cell can hold any action: a shortcut, macro, shell command or system action.

In the popup, click a cell or press its key: the cells follow the keyboard rows Q–T, A–G and Z–B. Tab switches pages; digits open a page by its number.
